purpose: Field registry for the Spatially Variable Gene Detection Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON. Do not add aliases as row names.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label for the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the frozen registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates Gaussian-process, kernel, non-parametric, cell-type-specific, conditional, and pattern-mining methods.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing, not parameter lists or callable signatures.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression-only, spatial-coordinate, cell-type-context, and tissue-pattern routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Spatially Variable Gene Detection.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the SVG, ctSVG, conditional, clustering, or gene-pattern role used in this topic.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps boundary methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to method selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as ranked SVGs, ctSVG calls, variation coefficients, or gene-pattern summaries.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes ranked/test outputs from clusters, coefficients, and pattern summaries.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only; do not create a global ranking.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison within decision branches.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence focused on method selection.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate without implying execution support.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without making runtime claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial datasets or high-resolution assays.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless method title, abstract, or benchmark evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps route large-data SVG tasks while preserving uncertainty.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current public code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with BioHarness runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later engineering audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when the frozen input or bounded verification supports a primary source; leave blank if unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable starting point for later audit, not an adapter claim.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or benchmark-supported interpretation.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note distinguishing direct evidence from Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: State the PubMed/DOI/code-link evidence separately from synthesized comparator, resource, benchmark, or caveat judgments.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence strength visible and prevents overclaiming.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the branch-local decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence; avoid runtime-failure claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse while staying in Layer 2.

fields.name: SVG Branch
fields.definition: Topic branch represented by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled branch value from the frozen registry subtask cues.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates broad SVG testing from ctSVG, conditional, pattern-mining, and clustering branches.

fields.name: Cell-Type Context
fields.definition: How cell type information enters the method-selection problem.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; use none when no cell type context is part of the method row.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights cell-type bias, deconvolution dependence, and branch fit.

fields.name: Primary Statistical Output
fields.definition: Dominant statistical or analytical output form for the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value matching the main output.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps agents distinguish result types that are not interchangeable.

fields.name: Spatial Pattern Scale
fields.definition: Coarse spatial scale or pattern framing used in method selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; prefer unclear when evidence is insufficient.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local choice for broad, local, multi-scale, cell-type-resolved, or tissue-pattern questions.

fields.name: Benchmark Coverage
fields.definition: Whether bounded screening found benchmark or review support relevant to the method branch.
fields.fill_rule: Use branch-local labels only; do not convert benchmark presence into a universal ranking.
fields.topic_relevance: Records benchmark/review screening strength and limits.

fields.name: Signal-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Concise scientific caveat about bias, calibration, pattern scale, cell type context, or boundary-task risk.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text grounded in method type, benchmark caveats, or explicit Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit in method selection.
